title: Executable Stage 2 exit gate
purpose: AGENTS section 9 states the Stage 2 exit gate in prose. This contract turns it into a re-runnable check that reads immutable evidence artifacts by checksum and reports each leg separately, so the gate flips on its own when the missing evidence arrives instead of being re-argued.

gate_statement.text: Held-out cellular, synaptic and circuit responses are predicted in time and amplitude, not merely activation order. Key predictions survive plausible parameter/model ensembles.

legs.requirement: A held-out cellular response is predicted in amplitude by a model frozen beforehand.
sufficiency_caveats: the held-out cells come from the same paper under a chronic-exposure state shift, not an independent laboratory
only firing rate is scored; resting voltage, membrane time constant and adaptation are not predicted by this model at all

legs.requirement: A held-out synaptic response is predicted in time and amplitude against preregistered numeric feature limits.
sufficiency_caveats: the amplitude leg is excluded from the gate because the held-out cells are state-shifted

legs.requirement: A held-out circuit response is predicted, not merely the activation order.
sufficiency_caveats: the reference is archived FlyWire simulation output, not biological response data, so even a pass here would not settle the circuit leg biologically

legs.requirement: Key predictions survive a plausible parameter and model ensemble of the VAL-01 shape.
sufficiency_caveats: the ensemble has the required five-by-four shape but every registered held-out recording is consumed, so no prediction has been scored across it

supporting_evidence.role: records which V1 observables are measured at all and for which cell classes
records whether contact number could carry the type-pair scale ND-04 requires

acceptance.partial_pass_is_not_a_pass: Stage 2 does not exit on a subset. A leg that passes is recorded so the remaining work is visible, not so the stage can be declared complete.

tier_policy: This contract evaluates a stage exit gate and awards no validation tier. Tiers are awarded only by immutable evidence bundles.
claim_boundary: A mechanical re-evaluation of the recorded Stage 2 exit criteria against checksum-pinned artifacts. It does not assess whether those criteria are the right ones.
